answer.rationale: The 18% spend cut and 14-day renewal deadline create urgency, but the 94% volume buffer leaves no margin for delivery failures. memory_c6 shows multi-year commitments unlock volume pricing; memory_c4 demonstrates renegotiation recovered margin through benchmarking. Before committing to renewal or switching (both high-risk given the tight timeline and zero buffer), aggressive renegotiation with the incumbent offers the fastest path to the required cost reduction while preserving the integration stability documented in memory_c1. memory_c2 warns against sole-sourcing a critical line with a low-cost vendor prone to SLA misses—this rules out switching. If renegotiation fails within 7 days, we defer and run month-to-month (memory_c5 precedent) while exploring second-source options in parallel, protecting both cost and delivery risk.
